title: relevance_tags_table.json
description: A reconnaissance topic's tagged-candidate table (docs/ROADMAP.md M4). Written by the reconnaissance-brief skill once a method manifest's capture.mode is "relevance_tags" -- see methods/_schema.json's capture.mode enum and tools/method.py's resolve(). Unlike charting_table.json / classification_table.json, there is no frozen field/facet form here: a reconnaissance brief tags each candidate with free-text relevance facets rather than co-developing and freezing a fixed form, so this schema has no freeze-gate concept at all.

facet_tags.description: Free-text relevance facets this candidate is closest on (e.g. "population", "method") -- the "closest on: [facet]" tags a prior-work-check output prints, never a frozen/co-developed field list.

claim.description: At most one quoted claim with provenance per candidate, the same provenance shape extraction_table.json / charting_table.json rows use.

hash.description: sha256 of the exact source text `quote` was taken from, so a later reviewer can verify it wasn't altered.
